# T-2: Apply taxonomy to run-review

<!-- Auto-generated by `sdd-forge spec render` from spec.json.tasks[]. Do not edit manually. -->

## Goal
Use the taxonomy in run-review so subprocess retry, provider / input size failures, reviewRetry consumption, and maxAttempts envelopes follow one contract.

## Acceptance Criteria
- R2 retry / non-retry decisions are derived from the taxonomy.
- R3 provider and input size failures return retryBudgetConsumed=false and do not append reviewRetry metrics.
- R4 maxAttempts envelope includes recoveryCommand.
- R9 machine-readable child review failure marker is parsed before raw stderr fallback.
- reviewStop is written and cleared according to the spec data_flow contract.

## Implementation Notes
Keep existing review verdict FAIL behavior separate from subprocess failure. Do not retry TEST_REVIEW_PROMPT_TOO_LARGE or signal / killed failures. Use a single-line stderr marker from src/flow/commands/review.js to carry provider/input classification to src/flow/lib/run-review.js.

## Test Strategy
Unit tests for runCmdWithRetry, checkReviewRetryBelowMax, provider/input failure envelopes, reviewRetry metric non-consumption, and the maximum 3 subprocess attempts bound.
